Messages.Author: SirTemple
Messages.Body:
How does Rutor's Hand work? Specifically, how does the damage prevention work?
Can I use combat cards, what about Flak Jackets, are there any other means of
preventing damage, etc..?

Jason

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
In article <19980217040...@ladder02.news.aol.com>,


While you strongly object to an absence of punctuation
(Article <19980217040...@ladder02.news.aol.com>),
I see that you do not object to incorrect use of punctuation.

Interesting position, that.

Anyway, to answer your question: damage from inferior Rutor's hand
cannot be prevented. Damage from superior Rutor's Hand has been
errata'ed to be treated as if from a strike in combat, so any
combat effects can be used to prevent or transmute this damage.
Examples are: Flak Jacket, Skin of Rock, Skin of Steel, Skin
of Night, and Merrill's special ability.

--
L. Scott Johnson (vte...@wizards.com)

LSJ, may it be that you shot over the line?

I still believe that Rutor's hand is NOT a strike. The Errata (from you)
tells me likewise.
I found this in DejaNews:

Subject: VTES Errata/Corrections
From: LSJ <vte...@wizards.com>
Date: 1998/02/04
Message-ID: <34D86B...@wizards.com>

Article Segment 3 of 4
(Get Previous Segment)
(Get All 4 Segments)

(snipped all other)

Rutor's Hand [DS] - Action (th) (1)

* To prevent the damage from Rutor's Hand (superior
version), treat it as if you are being struck in combat
(i.e., use combat cards, Flak Jackets, etc.)
[TOM 951208]

So: Can RH be prevented by Leather Jacket? IMHO: No.

Michael Beer
